card.name: Government office and ministry names
card.fires_on: The word 'of' or 'and' inside names of government bodies, such as 'Office of' or 'Ministry of Children and Youth', mostly in EPA and agency citations.

modes.label: Office of / Ministry of
modes.description: The word 'of' right after Office or Ministry in an agency name.
modes.example: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Office<< of>> Pollution Prevention and Toxics.

modes.label: Inside agency name
modes.description: A linking or name word partway through a government body's title.
modes.example: Ministry of Children<< and>> Youth Grand Erie District School Board

card.writes: It seems to lower words meaning 'department' (mostly Chinese terms), so the model expects the rest of an agency name rather than a generic department word.
card.plain: It fires inside the names of government offices and ministries, on words like 'of' in 'Office of'.
